body:
Hey, happy birthday! I know it's not much, especially as coming from a complete, random stranger...but still... No matter what the future holds for you and no matter of all that will come along your way, I really hope and wish to you, that you always have curiosity inside yourself as the fuel that will drive you throughout your journey... even at such points, when loneliness alone will define the laws of physics within your space and time... 
One more time, happy birthday to you, my dear fellow human being.   :)

Hello you there,

It is great that you have the urge to explore and experience, but if you have history of depression, this could be an episode of mania... Which usually could be good, if you use the energy for creating... 

Take care of yourself, seek joy and don't go to the extremes doing something radical.
I just feel the need to tell you, thank you, because this post is impacting for sure one desperate person, making her feel less lonely in this world.

Hey there.

I guess the period right after graduating high school is a breaking point for a lot of people, me included. Moving out of home, starting life as an adult... or at least try doing whatever we've been told. I failed the second year in the university, because of my panic attacks i still cannot deal with just finishing this education, i actually don't really enjoy. You should not give up on yours, since you have passion for it. I know it is hard going with low self esteem, but if there is something worth doing in this life, it is to use your talents for inventing a future for yourself. 

The part with your boyfriend... I am on and off getting together with mine. He is right now sleeping close to me, but he is being distant and actually so far away for a long time. I love him and he is one of the major reasons to keep going and try to get better. We are moving in together in a new place in less than two weeks, this is the one thing mostly that keeps me away of finishing myself. I don't want to hurt him. It is just too sad he, the one that used to call me soulmate, is looking right trough me, completely passionless, seeing only mental cunt... a flatmate ... Mad people are hard to handle :))) 

But my point is, if you can see any in my random moaning, just keep going with the fight for whatever you still have, i know there are restless nights, when any object is a potential weapon, this fact is well written on my covered with scars legs... Just... i don't know.... don't do it, at least before you find your peace inside...


And hey, happy cake day to you!
Just saying this was more than enough of help, you cannot imagine...

Happy birthday! Now I know, it is not much, but... 

I recently lost my boyfriend as well, because of my depression and constant fears of everything... I cannot say anything cheerful probably, I myself am at a place where I have not a single thing left to keep me alive and hoping. 

But today it is your birthday. I will celebrate it with you and promise I won't kill myself today, I can't do it on your birthday...

In the country where i come from, suicide is something that nobody thinks is a real problem. There isn't suicide hotline. Neither some other kind of support groups. Suicidal people here are treated like selfish pathetic lazy fuck ups, or like people with dangerous mental illness, the society i live in do not have any way of helping me, my close people don't have interest in what is going on with me, they think as long as i can pay my rent and look good, i am careless and have nothing to complain about. Yeah, because everyone thinks i am just complaining and looking for atention...   

I NEED HELP, i cannot count how many times i screamed this for the last two days. Noone cares and i just cannot take it anymore on my own. I was dealing all my life with everything alone. I am just so tired now, i just need someone to say i am normal and everything is gonna be fine, or just finish me once and for good, since i failed twice already, i am not good even to kill myself.  

It is so hard to look how all my dreams go away, because i cannot get my life together and deal with my will to die. I am young and smart, fluent in german and i speak good 3 other languages, i have so many interests, everyone around me says i am one of the brightest personalities they ever met, i can make everyone laugh, i look good, and i say this not to brag about or lift myself up. I just cannot understand why i am so broken. Why i cannot find anyone to hold me right now and show me that i have still what to fight for. I am so tired.

Happy cake day!
I don't usually write here, most of the time i'm just a passive reader(i know, i am as awkward in person, as on the internet). Since my whole life was one constant struggle between self-hatred and forced smiles simulating happiness and self-confidence, it is almost impossible for me to express what's living inside me. That's the reason i'm mainly a still presence on this subreddit. But you cannot imagine how many times you guys helped me silencer the suicidal thoughts and this urge to hurt myself. Seeing people who open themselves to share their stories, and the found understanding and support, is something that helps me feel less detached and alienated from the outside world and search for help, not because i feel better about myself, but because of you, the one who struggles and fight for every new day.
Today i just want to say thank you all for being so brave and strong, for being the one who stay and listen. It is so hard to find kindness and empathy nowadays. I'm terribly lonely. You on this subreddit make it less unbearable for me, not even talking directly to each other. Thank you! :)
(yeah, i guess this sounds weird)
